_about: Issue #308. The UK Standard Visitor rulebook v2 as served on dev (read-only copy, trimmed to the fields the assessment engine reads; source quotes clipped), the intake answers of the QA application the issue names, and what its stored assessment recorded BEFORE the fix. No applicant personal data: the answers are QA test values and the judgement text is not copied.

intakeQuestions.label: What are you applying for?

options.label: Entry clearance as a Visitor (a visit visa)
Permission to stay as a Visitor (extending a stay while in the UK)

intakeQuestions.label: Are you in the UK now?
Do you want to come to the UK as a Visitor for more than 6 months?
Do you intend to go on from the UK to another part of the Common Travel Area?
Are you required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) before travelling to the UK?
Did you enter the UK with permission to enter as a crew member?
Are you the dependant of another person whose permission is, or has been, cancelled?
Is any of the money you are relying on held in a currency other than pounds sterling (£)?
Was any of the money earned or acquired while you were in the UK?
Will you receive any payment from a UK source for activities in the UK?
Will someone else provide your travel, maintenance or accommodation?
Is the person supporting you an individual, such as a friend or family member, providing financial support?
Are you coming to look after a child or relative?
Will you arrive directly into UK waters to carry out activities in those waters, without first entering the UK landmass?
Are you coming to the UK as a participant on an Erasmus+ mobility project?
Which Erasmus+ activities will you do in the UK?

options.label: coming as an invited expert to provide training to members of staff at a UK-based organisation or educational institution
a short traineeship placement (up to 30 days)
job shadowing at a UK-based organisation or educational institution
job shadowing and coaching and training assignments at a UK-based sports organisation

intakeQuestions.label: Are you coming to the UK to act as a surrogate mother?
Has all or most of the money you are relying on been paid into your account only recently?
When do you plan to arrive in and leave the UK?
Are you a British citizen, or do you have right of abode in the UK?
Are you currently in breach of UK immigration laws (for example, staying after your permission ended)?
Are you on immigration bail?
Has the UK ever excluded you, or are you the subject of an exclusion order, a deportation order or a decision to make a deportation order?
Has the Home Office ever decided that you are excluded from refugee or humanitarian protection, or that you are a danger to the UK?
Have you ever been convicted of a criminal offence in the UK or any other country, or received an out-of-court disposal that is recorded on your criminal record?
Have you committed repeated offences, or any offence that caused serious harm?
Are you, or have you ever been, involved in a sham marriage or sham civil partnership?
Have you failed to pay any litigation costs awarded to the Home Office?
Has a medical inspector advised that for medical reasons it is undesirable to let you enter the UK?
Have you been rough sleeping in the UK, repeatedly refused offers of suitable support and engaged in persistent anti-social behaviour?
What is the name of the bank or financial institution holding the money, and in which country does it operate?
Is the financial institution regulated by the official regulatory body in the country where it operates?
Does the financial institution keep its records electronically?
Does any of the balance you are relying on come from an overdraft facility?
Can the money be accessed immediately, without any notice period?
Does the account holder have control of the funds?
Are you relying on a promise that someone will give you money in the future?
What is the date of your most recent financial document (for example the closing balance date on your latest statement)?
What period do your financial documents cover?
What is your date of birth?
What payment will you receive from a UK source, and what is it for?
How much do you expect your visit to cost in total, including your return or onward journey, any dependants and planned activities?
What is your relationship with the person supporting you?
Is the person supporting you in breach of UK immigration laws, or will they be when you enter the UK?
Can and will the person supporting you provide support for the whole of your stay?
What are the start and end dates of your current permission in the UK?
Describe your main reason for visiting, what you plan to do in the UK and for how long.
Describe your family, work and other ties to your country of residence, including any long-term commitments.
In which country are you registered for tax purposes?
Have you ever been refused a UK visa or permission under the Family rules (for example as a partner or family member of a British or settled person)?
What regular financial commitments do you have in your country of residence (for example rent or mortgage), and who do you support financially, including people not travelling with you?
How many people normally depend on the person supporting you, and what money do they have available?
Describe the care arrangement, how long it will last and whether you will be paid.
Do you intend to act as an au pair for a family in the UK?
Do you have a sponsor for your work in UK waters?
Do you intend to teach pupils at a UK school or other educational institution?
What are the start and end dates of your traineeship placement?
What is the most hours you will work in any one week during your traineeship?
Will you perform as an athlete as part of your Erasmus+ placement?
What is the name of the home institution where you are enrolled?
Do you plan to do any work in the UK, such as a job, work for a UK organisation, running a business, a work placement or internship, or selling goods or services?
Tell us about your previous travel, including visits to the UK and other countries.
Do you have family members living in the UK?
Has your sponsor or any immediate family member ever used, or tried to use, deception in an application to the Home Office?
Where did this money come from?
